lead: A hover card: a preview shown when the pointer hovers over a link or the keyboard focuses it. Its look fully reuses the theme styles of [Popover](/popover).

api.title: API Reference
api.parts: `PreviewCard.Title` / `PreviewCard.Description` are a plain `h2` / `p` that look like Popover's title and description. Don't use `Popover.Title` here: it depends on Popover's context and throws inside a hover card.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: PreviewCard has no CSS file of its own: its whole look comes from `popover.css`. As with every overlay, `data-skein-theme` must be set on `<html>`.
styling.slots: Popover's slots, reused; no extra styles needed
styling.preview: Set on `popover`, for theme styles that want to tell hover cards apart
